item.title: President Lee: "Considering Closure of Sites Like Ilbe"… Government-Wide Response to 'Hate' (이 대통령 “일베 같은 사이트 폐쇄 검토”…정부 차원서 ‘혐오’ 대응 뜻)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 24th that he will review legal sanctions, including website closures, for online communities that promote or tolerate hate speech, specifically pointing to Ilbe Storehouse (Ilbe). This comes after President Lee recently criticized Starbucks' "May 18 Tank Marketing" as "inhumane and outrageous behavior," signaling the government's intention to address the culture of hate and mockery spreading across society. (이재명 대통령이 24일 일간베스트저장소(일베)를 지목하며 혐오 표현을 조장하거나 방치하는 인터넷 커뮤니티에 대해 누리집 폐쇄를 포함한 법적 제재를 하는 방안을 검토하겠다고 말했다. 최근 스타벅스 ‘5·18 탱크 마케팅’을 “비인간적 막장 행태”라고 비판한 이 대통령이 사회 전반에 번진 혐오와 조롱 문화에 정부 차원의 대응을 하겠다는 뜻을 표시한 것이다.)

On this day, President Lee shared on X (formerly Twitter) a media report covering claims by Roh Moo-hyun Foundation Director Jo Su-jin, writing: "There are coexisting arguments that mockery and insults like those on Ilbe, which incite social division and conflict, should be protected as free speech, and that sanctions including punishment are necessary. There has been controversy over shutting down Ilbe." He added, "Under strict conditions, we need public debate and actual review of measures such as punishment and punitive damages for mockery and hate speech, and closure, punitive damages, fines, etc., for sites like Ilbe that tolerate or promote mockery and hate. I will also direct this at the Cabinet meeting." Director Jo posted on Facebook on the 23rd, stating, "After the memorial service for former President Roh Moo-hyun, I received a serious report. Young people presumed to be from Ilbe entered the Bongha Village memorial hall, wearing Ilbe T-shirts and making hand gestures symbolizing Ilbe while taking photos." Ilbe is a major far-right online community known for producing and distributing expressions and images that mock or insult the late President Roh. (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 조수진 노무현재단 이사의 주장을 다룬 언론 보도를 공유하며 “일베처럼 조롱 모욕으로 사회분열, 갈등을 조장하는 데 대해 표현의 자유로 보호해야 한다는 주장과 처벌을 포함한 제재가 필요하다는 주장이 병존한다. 일베 폐쇄 논란도 있었지요”라고 썼다. 이어 “엄격한 조건하에 조롱, 혐오 표현에 대한 처벌과 징벌배상, 일베처럼 조롱, 혐오를 방치 조장하는 사이트 폐쇄, 징벌배상, 과징금 등 필요한 조치를 허용하는 데 대한 공론화와 실제 검토가 필요해 보인다”며 “국무회의에도 지시하겠다”고 말했다. 조 이사는 지난 23일 페이스북에 “(노무현 전 대통령) 추도식을 마치고 보고받은 심각한 내용”이라며 “일베로 추정되는 청년들이 봉하마을 기념관에 들어와서 곳곳에서 일베 티셔츠를 입은 채로 (일베를) 상징하는 손가락 표시를 하며 사진을 찍었다”라는 글을 올렸다. 일베는 노 전 대통령 서거를 조롱하거나 모욕하는 표현과 이미지 등을 생산·유통하는 대표적인 극우 성향 온라인 커뮤니티다.)

President Lee's remarks on this day appear to stem from the recognition that hate and mockery in online communities have crossed a threshold and can no longer rely solely on internal self-regulation. Additionally, as seen in the controversy over Starbucks' "May 18 Tank Day" marketing—which President Lee condemned as "inhumane and outrageous behavior denying community and democratic values"—hate codes originating from some far-right communities are spilling into real-world spaces like corporate marketing, prompting the government to decide that action is necessary. (이 대통령의 이날 발언은 인터넷 커뮤니티상의 혐오와 조롱이 임계치를 넘어 더는 내부 자정에만 기댈 수 없다는 인식에서 비롯된 것 같다. 아울러 이 대통령은 자신이 “공동체와 민주의 가치를 부정하는 비인간적 막장 행태”라고 성토한 스타벅스의 ‘5·18 탱크데이’ 마케팅 파문에서 보듯 일부 극우 커뮤니티에서 생산된 혐오 코드가 기업 마케팅 등 현실 공간에서 표출되면서 정부 차원의 대처가 필요하다고 판단한 것으로 보인다.)

In response, Democratic Party of Korea spokesperson Lee Ju-hee stated, "We will broadly review legislative alternatives, including fines and closure measures for platforms that prevent or promote hate content under constitutional standards and strict requirements, as well as punishment and punitive damages for mockery and hate speech." However, People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk sarcastically remarked, "Lee Jae-myung says he'll shut down Ilbe. 'Freedom of speech' only for North Korea-praising sites?" (이에 이주희 더불어민주당 원내대변인은 “헌법적 기준과 엄격한 요건 아래 혐오 콘텐츠를 방지·조장하는 플랫폼에 대한 과징금과 폐쇄 조치, 조롱·혐오 표현에 대한 처벌과 징벌배상 도입을 포함한 입법적 대안을 폭넓게 검토해나가겠다”고 말했다. 그러나 장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 “이재명이 일베 폐쇄하겠다고 한다”며 “북한 찬양 사이트들만 누리는 ‘표현의 자유?’”라고 비꼬았다.)

Reporters: Shim Woo-sam, Ko Han-sol, Kim Hae-jung wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 고한솔 김해정 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic-Progressive Ulsan Mayor Candidate Unification Stumbles... Kim Sang-wook Camp Suspends Poll (민주-진보 울산시장 후보 단일화 삐걱…김상욱 캠프 여론조사 중단)
item.description:
The unification of the Democratic Party of Korea and the Progressive Party's candidates for the Ulsan mayoral election in the June 3 local elections is hitting a snag. Both sides said that "the unification has not fallen through," but it remains uncertain whether they can complete the process before early voting begins on the 29th. (더불어민주당과 진보당의 6·3 지방선거 울산시장 후보 단일화가 삐걱이고 있다. 양쪽은 ‘단일화가 결렬된 것은 아니다’라고 했지만 오는 29일 사전투표 시작 전까지 단일화를 마칠 수 있을지 미지수다.)

On the morning of the 24th, the last day of the two-day unification poll, the camp of Kim Sang-wook, the Democratic Party's Ulsan mayoral candidate, released a statement saying, "We are suspending the poll for unification," and added, "Circumstances are being found that suggest organized interference by certain forces." The camp further stated, "We will identify the cause and continue the unification process through subsequent consultations with the Progressive Party." It is known that Kim's camp believes members of the Shincheonji sect or supporters of the People Power Party are interfering in the poll to make reverse choices. <<> The camp of Kim Jong-hoon, the Progressive Party's Ulsan mayoral candidate, opposed this. Kim Jong-hoon's camp said, "Kim Sang-wook's unilateral declaration to suspend the poll is incomprehensible," and urged for the poll to resume, stating, "The only way (to prevent disruption) is for Kim to proceed with the poll normally." The two candidates had originally planned to announce the unified candidate based on the poll results on the night of the 24th. <<> Cho Seung-rae, the Democratic Party's general election campaign headquarters chief, said, "The unification is still valid, but the survey has been suspended." Jeong Hye-gyu, the Progressive Party's spokesperson, said, "Even now, carry out the primary as agreed." <<> Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (김상욱 민주당 울산시장 후보 캠프는 이틀간의 단일화 여론조사 마지막날인 24일 오전 입장문을 내고 “단일화를 위한 여론조사를 중단한다”며 “일부 세력의 조직적 개입이 의심되는 정황이 발견되고 있다”고 했다. 캠프는 이어 “원인을 파악하고 진보당 쪽과 후속 협의를 통해 단일화를 계속 진행하겠다”고 덧붙였다. 김 후보 쪽은 신천지 신도나 국민의힘 지지층이 여론조사에 개입해 역선택을 하고 있다고 보는 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: Han In-ok, Wife of Former Grand National Party Leader Lee Hoi-chang, Passes Away at 88 (‘이회창 전 총재 부인’ 한인옥 여사 별세…향년 88)
item.description:
Han In-ok, the wife of Lee Hoi-chang, former leader of the Grand National Party (predecessor of the People Power Party), passed away on the 24th. She was 88. (이회창 전 한나라당(국민의힘 전신) 총재의 부인 한인옥 여사가 24일 별세했다. 향년 88.)

Born in Haman, South Gyeongsang Province, in 1938, the deceased graduated from Gyeonggi Girls’ High School and the Department of Home Economics Education at Seoul National University’s College of Education. Her father was former Supreme Court Justice Han Seong-su. (1938년 경남 함안에서 태어난 고인은 경기여고와 서울대 사범대 가정교육과를 졸업했다. 고인의 아버지는 한성수 전 대법관이다.)

The deceased married former leader Lee in 1962. She is recognized for her steadfast support, offering advice and silently assisting her husband during his campaigns as the Grand National Party’s presidential candidate in 1997 and 2002, both of which ended in defeat. Notably, during former leader Lee’s 2002 presidential bid, she reportedly said, “Even if the sky splits in two, we must win the presidential election,” a remark that drew public attention. (고인은 1962년 이 전 총재와 결혼했다. 1997년과 2002년 이 전 총재가 한나라당 대통령 선거 후보로 출마했다가 낙선했던 시기를 포함해 남편 곁에서 조언을 건네며 묵묵히 내조했다는 평가를 받는다. 특히 2002년 이 전 총재가 대선 후보로 출마했을 때 “하늘이 두 쪽 나도 대선에서 이겨야 한다”고 말한 사실이 알려져 주목받기도 했다.)

Former lawmaker Yoo Seung-min, who regarded former leader Lee as his “political mentor,” paid tribute on Facebook that day, saying, “She was someone who always maintained her elegant dignity” and “a warm person who gave me courage whenever I faced trials.” She is survived by former Prime Minister Lee, two sons, and one daughter. (이 전 총재를 ‘정치적 스승’이라 해 온 유승민 전 의원은 이날 페이스북에 “항상 단아한 기품을 잃지 않으셨던 분”이라며 “제가 시련을 겪을 때마다 용기를 주시던 따뜻한 분”이라고 추모했다. 유족으로는 이 전 총리와 아들 2명, 딸 1명이 있다.)

The funeral hall is set up in Special Room No. 2 at the funeral center of Sinchon Severance Hospital in Seodaemun-gu, Seoul. The burial ceremony will take place on the 26th at 8:20 a.m., with the burial site at Gwangneung Memorial Park. (빈소는 서울 서대문구 신촌세브란스병원 장례식장 특2호실에 마련됐다. 발인은 오는 26일 오전 8시20분, 장지는 광릉추모공원이다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Defending Starbucks Doesn't Help the People Power Party at All"... Political Analysts Point to a 'Misstep' (“스벅 옹호 국힘에 전혀 도움 안돼”…정치 평론가들 ‘악수’ 지적)
item.description:
Amid the Starbucks Korea '5·18 Tank Day' marketing controversy emerging as a major issue in the June 3 local elections, political analysts criticized the People Power Party (PPP), including its leader Jang Dong-hyuk, for defending Starbucks, stating it does not benefit the election. (스타벅스코리아의 ‘5·18 탱크데이’ 마케팅 문제가 6·3 지방선거 최대 쟁점으로 떠오른 가운데 정치평론가들은 장동혁 대표를 포함한 국민의힘이 스타벅스를 옹호하는 것은 선거에 도움이 되지 않는다고 비판했다.)

Choi Chang-ryul, a professor at Yongin University, told The Hankyoreh on the 24th, "The PPP's defense of Starbucks will cause centrist conservatives to defect," adding, "People who have a favorable view of the Democratic Party but were reluctant to vote for them might now head to the polls." He said, "Starbucks' Tank Day marketing is unacceptable. The PPP should have said Starbucks must not do this. If they had, it could have been a good opportunity to expand support to the center." Choi added, "This reveals the anachronistic and regressive mindset prevalent within the PPP's base, so it won't help the election at all." <<> Shin Yul, a professor of political science and diplomacy at Myongji University, also told The Hankyoreh, "May 18 is not a matter of conservative versus progressive. It is the most tragic event in modern Korean history, where countless innocent civilians were slaughtered for power." He stated, "(The PPP defending Starbucks) is absolutely not good for conservatives." He added, "Since it's a fact that Starbucks engaged in behavior that could cause misunderstanding, they (the PPP) must first accept that." <<> Political analyst Park Sang-byung assessed that it could have some impact in the Yeongnam region, rather than in Seoul or the metropolitan area elections. He predicted, "Looking at voter behavior in places like Seoul, people won't change their votes just because of Starbucks," but added, "It has become a basis for conservatives to rally, so regions like Daegu and North Gyeongsang may unite tightly. Conversely, in Gwangju, the Democratic Party's support base will solidify." <<> Park Sung-min, CEO of political consulting firm Min, said, "Both the president and the PPP are going overboard," noting, "The company already apologized and made its CEO step down, yet having state agencies step in to sever ties and investigate is excessive. On the other hand, the PPP's call to 'post Starbucks coffee certification shots' is also excessive." <<> Reporter Jung Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr ( 최창렬 용인대 교수는 24일 한겨레에 “국힘의 스타벅스 (옹호) 발언이 중도 보수층의 이탈을 가져올 것”이라며 “더불어민주당에 호감은 갖고 있지만 거기에 투표까지는 안 하려던 사람들이 투표장으로 갈 수 있다”고 말했다. 그는 “스타벅스의 탱크데이 마케팅은 있을 수 없는 것이다. 국힘은 스타벅스가 이렇게 하면 안 된다고 해야 했다. 그렇게 했다면 지지를 중도로 확장할 수 있는 좋은 계기가 될 수 있었다”고 말했다. 최 교수는 “국민의힘 저변에 흐르는 시대착오적이고 퇴행적인 인식을 그대로 보여준 거라 선거에 전혀 도움이 안 될 것”이라고 덧붙였다. )

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "Starbucks boycott is a people's court for elections... Lee Jae-myung will carry it around after that day." (장동혁 “스벅 불매는 선거용 인민재판…이재명, 그날 지나면 들고다닐 것”)
item.description:
People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk said on the 25th, "This Friday (the 29th), when early voting takes place, let the people clearly show the will of free citizens that 'I choose my own coffee.'" (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 25일 “(사전투표가 있는) 이번 금요일(29일) 국민들께서 ‘내 커피는 내가 고른다’는 자유시민 의지 확실하게 보여주자”고 말했다.)

PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk made this remark while holding a central election committee meeting at the PPP headquarters in Yeouido, Seoul, on the 25th, stating, "This election is a confrontation between Lee Jae-myung and his 'Gaeddal' followers versus free citizens." Jang criticized President Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party for attacking Starbucks over its 'May 18 Tank Day' marketing and the government's boycott movement, calling it a "people's court for local elections." He aims to make 'Starbucks' a key issue in the June 3 local elections ahead of early voting on the 29th. <<> Jang said, "I'll make a prediction. The Starbucks boycott period will last exactly until June 3rd," adding, "Lee Jae-myung, the Democratic Party, and all the 'Gaeddal' followers will carry Starbucks coffee as if nothing happened once that day passes." <<> Jang continued, "In 2016, the Democratic Party put on all kinds of shows over the THAAD electromagnetic waves," and "As soon as the 2017 presidential election ended, the opposition to THAAD disappeared without a trace. Moon Jae-in came out in favor of THAAD deployment within a month of taking office." He added, "In 2023, the Democratic Party incited the entire nation over Fukushima's nuclear wastewater," and "Have you seen the Democratic Party mention Fukushima after the 2024 general election? Lee Jae-myung even went to Japan to discuss importing Fukushima seafood." Jang stated, "The target of this election is Starbucks," and "They are trying to divert public anger over the special counsel to cancel Lee Jae-myung's trial toward Starbucks." <<> Floor leader Song Eon-seok also said, "Ahead of the recent elections, President Lee Jae-myung's social media (SNS) politics, targeting Starbucks and Musinsa, is spiraling out of control." Song urged, "The president should immediately stop interfering in the elections and focus on taking care of the people's livelihoods and the economy." <<> Reporter Cho Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 25일 서울 여의도 국민의힘 당사에서 중앙 선거대책위원회의를 열고 “이번 선거는 이재명·개딸과 자유시민의 대결”이라며 이같이 말했다. 장 대표는 이재명 대통령과 더불어민주당이 ‘5·18 탱크데이’ 마케팅을 한 스타벅스를 비판하고 정부가 불매 움직임에 나선 것은 “지방선거용 인민재판”이라고 말했다. 29일 사전투표를 앞두고 ‘스타벅스’를 6·3 지방선거 쟁점으로 삼겠다는 것이다.)

item.title: Kim Jong-un Sends Condolence Message to Xi Jinping Over ‘Coal Mine Explosion’ Accident (김정은, 시진핑에 ‘탄광 폭발’ 사고 위로 전문)
item.description:
Amid speculation over Chinese President Xi Jinping’s possible visit to North Korea, Kim Jong-un, Chairman of the State Affairs Commission of North Korea and General Secretary of the Workers’ Party of Korea, sent a condolence message over the coal mine gas explosion accident in China’s Shanxi Province. (시진핑 중국 국가주석의 방북 가능성이 거론되는 가운데, 김정은 북한 국무위원장 겸 노동당 총비서가 중국 산시성에서 발생한 석탄 광산 가스 폭발 사고를 위로하는 전문을 보냈다.)

The Rodong Sinmun reported on the 25th that Chairman Kim sent a condolence message to President Xi the previous day (the 24th). Chairman Kim stated, “Upon receiving the sad news of a large number of casualties caused by a coal mine gas explosion in Shanxi Province of your country, I extend deep condolences to Comrade General Secretary (Xi Jinping), the Chinese Party, government, and people, and the bereaved families,” adding, “I sincerely hope that under the leadership of the Chinese Communist Party and the Chinese government, with Comrade General Secretary at the core, the Chinese people will quickly overcome the aftermath of the disaster, and the bereaved families will overcome their sorrow and restore a stable life.” The newspaper placed Chairman Kim’s message on the front page. <<> On the 22nd, at the Liuxianyu coal mine of the Tongzhou Group in Qinyuan County, Shanxi Province, China, a gas explosion resulted in a catastrophe with at least 82 deaths. There are 128 injured and 2 missing. This is a large-scale disaster expected to be the deadliest coal mine accident in China since 2009. <<> The exchange between Chairman Kim and President Xi through the condolence message took place amid speculation over President Xi’s possible visit to North Korea. Following the US-China summit in Beijing on the 15th, there are observations that President Xi might visit North Korea between late this month and early next month for a North Korea-China summit. <<> Chairman Kim previously sent a condolence message to Russian President Vladimir Putin in December of last year when a passenger plane crash occurred in Russia’s Far East region. At that time, Chairman Kim used expressions revealing solidarity between the two peoples, such as, “Our people are sharing the misfortune and sorrow of the fraternal Russian people,” or “Our people will always be with the Russian people.” However, such content is absent from the message sent to President Xi. <<> Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (노동신문은 김 위원장이 전날(24일) 시 주석에게 위문전문을 보냈다고 25일 보도했다. 김 위원장은 “나는 귀국의 산시성에서 탄광가스 폭발사고로 많은 인명피해가 발생했다는 슬픈 소식에 접하고 (시진핑) 총서기 동지와 중국당과 정부와 인민, 피해 유가족들에게 깊은 위문을 표한다”며 “총서기 동지를 핵심으로 하는 중국공산당과 중국정부의 영도 밑에 중국 인민이 피해의 후과를 하루빨리 가시며 유가족들이 슬픔을 이겨내고 안정된 생활을 되찾기를 진심으로 바란다”고 했다. 신문은 김 위원장의 전문을 1면에 배치했다.)

item.title: Yoo Eui-dong: "President Lee Criticizes Usury, But Turns Blind Eye to Kim Yong-nam's 'Loan Shark Allegations'?" (유의동 “고리대금업 비판 이 대통령, 김용남 ‘대부업체 의혹’엔 눈감나 ”)
item.description:
In the by-election for the Pyeongtaek-eul National Assembly seat, the allegation of Kim Yong-nam, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate, having "operated a loan shark company under a borrowed name" has emerged as a major variable. Following the Rebuilding Korea Party's full-scale offensive demanding "consideration of the candidate's position and Democratic Party inspection," Yoo Eui-dong, the People Power Party candidate, also called for Kim's withdrawal, stating he would "pursue legal steps." (경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에서 김용남 더불어민주당 후보의 ‘대부업체 차명 운영 의혹’이 최대 변수로 떠올랐다. 조국혁신당이 해당 의혹에 대해 “김 후보의 거취 숙고와 민주당 감찰”을 요구하며 총공세에 나선 데 이어, 유의동 국민의힘 후보도 김 후보의 사퇴를 촉구하며 “고발 수순을 밟겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Candidate Yoo held an emergency press conference at the People Power Party headquarters in Yeongdeungpo, Seoul, on the 25th, saying, "The loan shark industry is a highly sensitive sector directly tied to people's economic lives, and operating under another's name is strictly prohibited." He added, "Candidate Kim, a former prosecutor, is trying to twist the law to explain himself, but even that is inconsistent." Yoo canceled his scheduled Pyeongtaek-eul campaign rally to hold the press conference. (유 후보는 25일 서울 영등포 국민의힘 당사에서 긴급 기자회견을 열고 “대부업은 국민 경제생활과 직결되는 매우 민감한 업종이고, 타인 명의 운영은 엄격히 금지돼 있다”며 “김 후보는 검찰 출신으로 법을 교묘히 비틀어 해명하고 있지만 그조차 앞뒤가 맞지 않는다”고 말했다. 그는 이날 예정돼 있던 평택을 선거 유세를 중단하고 회견을 열었다.)

Yoo further stated, "President Lee Jae-myung has said that usury is a sign of national ruin, but can he turn a blind eye to the allegations of borrowed-name loan shark operations by Kim Yong-nam, the icon of 'New Lee Jae-myung'?" He added, "This election is a by-election caused by property issues of the former Democratic Party lawmaker, yet they've put forward a candidate embroiled in allegations of operating a loan shark company under a borrowed name in front of Pyeongtaek citizens. Even if Candidate Kim is elected, there's a high chance the election will again be invalidated." (유 후보는 또 “이재명 대통령은 고리대금업은 망국의 징조라는 취지로 말해 왔는데, ‘뉴 이재명’의 아이콘 김용남 후보의 타인 명의 대부업 의혹에는 눈감을 수 있는 것이냐”고 했다. 그러면서 “이번 선거는 전임 민주당 국회의원의 재산 관련 문제로 치러지는 재선거인데, 또다시 대부업체 차명 운영 의혹에 휩싸인 후보를 평택 시민 앞에 내세웠다”며 “만약 김 후보가 당선 되더라도 또다시 당선무효가 될 가능성이 높다”고 말했다.)

Earlier, on the 22nd, TV Chosun reported a recording from 2021 in which Candidate Kim, while talking to an acquaintance, said, "Dividends are all mine anyway," showing circumstantial evidence that he was effectively the real owner of a loan shark company. Candidate Kim denied the allegations, stating, "In the process of taking over my brother's agricultural corporation, which was in management crisis in 2020, (the loan shark company) was only included as a subsidiary, and I've already filed for closure and am preparing for liquidation." However, controversy continues as it was revealed that the company had renewed its loan shark registration. In his YouTube broadcast on the 24th, Candidate Kim reiterated, "I have never taken any profits, dividends, or salaries. I only learned about the license renewal through later reports." (앞서, 지난 22일 티브이(TV)조선은 2021년 김 후보가 지인과 대화하던 중 “배당은 어차피 다 내 것”이라며 사실상 본인이 대부업체 실소유주라는 정황을 보여주는 발언 등을 담은 녹취록을 보도했다. 김 후보는 “2020년 경영 위기에 처한 동생의 농업법인을 인수하던 과정에서 (대부업체가) 자회사로 포함됐을 뿐이고, 이미 폐업 신고를 마치고 청산 절차를 준비 중”이라고 의혹을 부인했다. 그러나 해당 업체가 대부업 등록을 갱신한 것으로 드러나 논란이 계속되고 있다. 김 후보는 24일 자신의 유튜브 방송에서도 “어떠한 수익이나 배당, 급여를 가져간 적 없다. 면허 갱신을 한 것도 사후적으로 보도를 보고 처음 알았다”고 거듭 밝혔다.)

item.title: Jeong Cheong-rae: "Far beyond the pale" in response to Kim Gwan-young's claim of consulting with the president on candidacy (정청래, ‘대통령과 출마 상의’ 김관영 주장에 “금도 한참 넘었다”)
item.description:
Jeong Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 25th, in response to North Jeolla Province Governor candidate Kim Gwan-young's statement that he had informed President Lee Jae-myung of his independent candidacy before declaring, "This is far beyond the pale, even beyond the limits," adding, "I hope he apologizes and provides an explanation to the president." (정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 25일 무소속 출마 전 이재명 대통령에 출마 사실을 전했다고 밝힌 김관영 전북지사 후보를 향해 “금도를 넘어도 한참 넘었다”며 “대통령에 사과하고 해명하길 바란다”고 말했다.)

At a central election committee meeting held at the campaign office of Jeongeup mayoral candidate Lee Hak-su in Jeongeup, North Jeolla Province, Representative Jeong stated, "When we checked with the presidential office, they strongly denied it, saying it's not true. If it's false as the presidential office claims, this is a serious case of spreading false information." He continued, "This is a dangerous gamble that puts the president in a difficult position. Surely, the president wouldn't have consulted with an independent candidate. If the person who made the statement needs to clarify and apologize in detail, let him do so." <<> "The development of North Jeolla requires legal and budgetary support, which is impossible without the Democratic Party," said Representative Jeong. "This election is an evaluation of the first year of the Lee Jae-myung administration. If you like and support President Lee, please vote for candidate Lee Won-taek." <<> Floor leader Han Byeong-do and other election committee members also continued their criticism and attacks on candidate Kim. In response to Kim's claim that Representative Jeong expelled him from the party to nominate his close associate Lee Won-taek, Floor leader Han said, "It's a rumor to create a political breakthrough for himself." He stressed the essence of the Democratic Party's decision to disqualify Kim was not Representative Jeong's "backroom deals" but "Kim's cash distribution." He added, "If we hadn't expelled him, can you imagine what would have happened the next day? The People Power Party would have mounted a total attack, and it would have clearly had a negative impact on the election nationwide. Don't drag the president and the presidential office into the election for your own political gain." <<> Yun Jun-byeong, chairman of the North Jeolla Provincial Party Committee, said to candidate Kim Gwan-young, "Despite committing clear illegal acts, he's trying to divert attention without any remorse or reflection." He questioned, "Moreover, he himself mentioned the possibility of his election being invalidated later at his campaign office opening ceremony. Who will take responsibility for the costs of the upcoming by-election, the suspension of provincial governance, and the burden on the residents?" He added, "This election is a crucial one to decide whether we regress to the days when opportunistic migratory birds toyed with provincial and municipal governance, or whether we properly seize the favorable opportunity for North Jeolla that has finally arrived with the Lee Jae-myung administration's efforts to normalize the country. I ask for the right choice." <<> Reporter Go Kyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr (정 대표는 이날 전북 정읍 이학수 정읍시장 후보 선거사무소에서 열린 현장 중앙선거대책위원회에서 “청와대에 확인하니 펄쩍 뛰며 사실이 아니라고 했다. 청와대 말처럼 사실이 아니라면 심각한 허위사실 유포”라며 이렇게 말했다. 그는 “대통령을 곤경에 빠뜨리는 위험한 도박이다. 아무렴 대통령이 무소속 후보와 상의했겠나”라며 “발언 당사자가 자세하게 직접 해명하고 사과할 일이 있다면 사과하라”고 말했다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Park Soo-young of People Power Party Posts Fake Starbucks Promotional Material Featuring ‘Drum Can Tumbler’? ([단독] 스벅에 ‘드럼통 텀블러’? ‘일베 가짜 홍보물’ 올린 국힘 박수영)
item.description:
Amid the People Power Party (PPP), including its leader Jang Dong-hyuk, rallying to defend Starbucks for denigrating the democratization movement through its ‘May 18 Tank Day’ marketing, PPP lawmaker Park Soo-young has sparked controversy by uploading a fake image that combines Starbucks’ ‘tank’ tumbler with a ‘drum can’—a term used by far-right netizens to insult President Lee Jae-myung. Park also shared a piece of ‘fake news’ claiming that ‘tanks were never deployed to suppress the May 18 Democratization Movement.’ (장동혁 대표를 포함해 국민의힘이 ‘5·18 탱크데이’ 마케팅으로 민주화운동을 폄훼한 스타벅스를 비호하고 나선 가운데, 박수영 국민의힘 의원이 스타벅스 ‘탱크’ 텀블러에 극우 누리꾼들이 이재명 대통령을 비하할 때 쓰는 ‘드럼통’을 합성한 가짜 사진을 올려 논란이 예상된다. 박 의원은 ‘5·18 민주화운동 진압에 탱크가 동원된 적 없다’는 취지의 ‘가짜 뉴스’도 공유했다.)

On the 23rd, Park posted on Facebook a promotional material introducing a drum-shaped tumbler, stating, “The reason Starbucks calls this tumbler a ‘tank’ in its stores is because of its unique design reminiscent of a drum can (oil tank).” The material repeatedly mentions ‘drum can,’ with phrases like “drum-shaped design” and “the cylindrical shape with grooves makes it look just like a drum can.” At the bottom of the drum-shaped tumbler, the product name ‘SS Drum Barrel Tumbler’ is written. (박 의원은 지난 23일 페이스북에 “스타벅스 매장에서 이 텀블러를 ‘탱크’라고 부르는 이유는, 드럼통(기름탱크)을 연상시키는 독특한 디자인 때문”이라며 드럼통 모양의 텀블러를 소개하는 홍보물을 올렸다. 이 홍보물은 ‘드럼통 모양의 디자인”, “원통형에 홈이 있어 마치 드럼통처럼 보인다” 등 여러 차례 ‘드럼통’을 언급하고 있다. 드럼통 모양의 텀블러 하단에는 ‘SS 드럼 배럴 텀블러’라는 제품명이 적혀 있기도 하다.)

Although it appears to be an official Starbucks promotional material, it is a fake composited using artificial intelligence (AI). A Starbucks official told The Hankyoreh on the 25th, “This is an image unrelated to our company.” In reality, the actual Starbucks ‘Tank Series’ tumbler has a smooth exterior, and the logo is positioned at the bottom of the tumbler, not in the middle like the fake version. (스타벅스의 공식 홍보물처럼 보이지만 이는 인공지능(AI)으로 합성한 가짜다. 스타벅스 관계자는 25일 한겨레에 “당사와 무관한 이미지”라고 밝혔다. 실제 스타벅스 ‘탱크 시리즈’ 텀블러는 외관이 매끄럽고 로고 위치도 가짜처럼 텀블러 중간이 아닌 텀블러 하단이다.)

The ‘fake’ promotional material, which Park shared on Facebook without properly verifying its authenticity, appears to contain an intent to disparage President Lee. The term ‘drum can’ is a malicious meme spread by far-right online communities like Ilbe (Ilgan Best Storage) during last year’s presidential election to demonize then-candidate Lee Jae-myung. This time, the fake Starbucks tumbler image shaped like a drum can is also spreading primarily among far-right communities like Ilbe. (박 의원이 진위를 제대로 확인하지 않은 채 페이스북에 공유한 ‘가짜’ 홍보물에는 이 대통령을 비하하려는 의도가 포함된 것으로 보인다. ‘드럼통’은 지난해 대선 때 이재명 당시 대통령 후보를 악마화하기 위해 일간베스트저장소(일베) 등 일부 극우 온라인 커뮤니티에서 확산시킨 악의적 ‘밈’이다. 이번에도 드럼통 모양의 ‘가짜’ 스타벅스 텀블러 이미지는 일베 등 극우 커뮤니티를 중심으로 확산하고 있다.)

This is essentially a ‘far-right lexicon’ used maliciously by only a small minority. PPP lawmaker Na Kyung-won even went so far as to post a photo of herself inside a drum can on Instagram last April, saying, “I’d rather enter a drum can than surrender.” The Democratic Party of Korea strongly criticized this at the time, stating, “The demonization of the Democratic Party has reached an intolerable level.” (극히 일부만 악의적으로 사용하는 ‘극우의 언어’인 셈인데, 나경원 국민의힘 의원은 지난해 4월 “드럼통에 들어갈지언정 굴복하지 않는다”며 직접 드럼통에 들어간 사진을 인스타그램에 올리기까지 했다. 이를 두고 더불어민주당은 “민주당에 대한 악마화가 인내할 수 없는 수준에 이르렀다”며 강하게 비판한 바 있다.)

The post that Park shared alongside the ‘fake’ promotional material is also controversial. Under the title ‘Posting by Jeonnam Poet Jeong Jae-hak,’ Park shared a column by Jeong titled “Let’s Save Jeong Yong-jin,” published in ‘Gyeonggi Daily’ on the 22nd. (박 의원이 ‘가짜’ 홍보물과 함께 공유한 글도 논란이다. 박 의원은 ‘전라도 시인 정재학 포스팅’이라는 제목으로 정씨가 지난 22일 ‘경기데일리’에 쓴 “정용진을 살립시다”라는 제목의 칼럼을 공유했다.)

The main content of Jeong’s column is ‘fake news’ about the May 18 Democratization Movement. Jeong claimed, “Simply put, has a tank ever been used in the May 18 incident?” adding, “Therefore, linking this commercial advertisement (by Starbucks) to the May 18 issue is an excessive logic.” (정씨 칼럼의 주된 내용은 5·18 민주화운동에 대한 ‘가짜뉴스’다. 정씨는 “한마디로 말해서, 5·18에 탱크가 동원된 적 있나”라며 “따라서 (스타벅스의) 이런 상업광고에 5·18 문제를 연결시킨다는 것은 지나친 논리”라고 주장했다.)

Contrary to Jeong’s claim, the new military junta led by Chun Doo-hwan deployed tanks to suppress the May 18 Democratization Movement, as evidenced by photographs and videos. (정씨 주장과 달리, 전두환 신군부는 5·18 민주화운동 진압을 위해 탱크를 동원했고 이는 사진과 영상으로 남아 있다.)

Jeong also made the malicious argument that “fake May 18 merit holders must be exposed.” He stated, “The PPP should be mobilized to proclaim and declare a ‘law demanding the disclosure of information on fake merit holders’ before the public,” and argued, “If Starbucks and Jeong Yong-jin collapse, how long will May 18 be protected by evil laws, and the fake merit holders will be hidden.” Jeong then urged, “Let’s send lots of support to Starbucks and rescue Jeong Yong-jin.” Far-right forces have repeatedly insisted on “exposing fake merit holders” in an effort to disparage the May 18 Democratization Movement and foster distrust and hatred toward its merit holders. (정씨는 ‘5·18 가짜유공자를 밝혀야 한다’는 악의적 주장도 펼쳤다. “국힘(국민의힘)을 동원하여 ‘가짜유공자 정보공개를 요구하는 법’을 국민 앞에 공포하고 천명해야 한다”며 “스타벅스와 정용진이 무너지면 5·18은 언제까지 악법의 보호를 받게 될 것이며 가짜유공자는 숨겨지게 될 것”이라는 주장이다. 그러면서 정씨는 “스타벅스에 많은 응원을 보내고 정용진을 구해내자”고 목소리를 높였다. 극우 세력은 5·18 민주화운동을 깎아내리고 유공자에 대한 불신과 혐오 조장을 위해 ‘가짜 유공자를 밝혀야 한다’는 주장을 반복해 온 바 있다.)

Park did not provide specifics on whether he agreed with the column or why he shared it. (박 의원은 정씨 칼럼을 공유하며 해당 글에 동의하는지, 공유한 이유는 무엇인지에 대해서는 구체적으로 밝히지 않았다.)

As of 10 a.m. on this day, Park’s Facebook post had received around 1,400 ‘likes’ and 273 comments. Most comments expressed support for Starbucks and disparaged the May 18 Democratization Movement, with remarks like “Disclose the list (of May 18 merit holders)” and “Let’s all change the nickname of Starbucks to ‘Tank Coffee Shop.’” However, one netizen countered Jeong’s column, saying, “Nonsense,” and adding, “The martial law forces’ M48 tanks were used to enter downtown Gwangju. Tanks weren’t deployed during May 18? Where do you get off telling such a blatant lie?” (박 의원 페이스북 글에는 이날 오전 10시 기준 ‘좋아요’ 1400여개와 댓글 273개가 달렸다. 대부분의 댓글에는 “(5·18 유공자) 명단을 공개하라”, “우리 모두 스벅을 ‘탱크 커피숍’이라 애칭을 바꿉시다” 등 스타벅스를 옹호하고 5·18 민주화운동을 폄훼하는 내용이 담겼다. 다만 한 누리꾼은 “개소리”라며 “계엄군 M48 전차가 광주 시내 진입에 사용됐다. 5·18에 탱크가 동원되지 않았다고? 어디서 뻔한 거짓말을 하나”라고 정씨 칼럼에 반박했다.)

Reporter Jeon Gwang-joon light@hani.co.kr and Reporter Lee Joo-bin yes@hani.co.kr (전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr 이주빈 기자 yes@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Innovation Party: "Jang Dong-hyuk, Who Abandoned the Chun Doo-hwan Trial, Leads and Shields the 'May 18 Insult'" (혁신당 “전두환 재판 그만둔 장동혁이 ‘5·18 모독’ 앞장서 비호”)
item.description:
The Fatherland Innovation Party on the 25th criticized People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk's remarks belittling the Starbucks boycott, stating, "Representative Jang is the person who, as a judge, neglected the judiciary's duty to punish Chun Doo-hwan, and now he is leading the way in shielding attempts to subtly insult the sacrifice and community spirit of the May 18 Uprising." <<> Park Byung-eon, spokesperson for the Innovation Party's central election committee, issued a commentary saying, "Chun Doo-hwan was put on trial for defamation after calling the late Father Jo Bi-oh, who testified to witnessing helicopter gunfire during the May 18 Democratization Movement, a 'shameless liar unworthy of being called a clergyman.' At the time, Representative Jang, who was the presiding judge, resigned midway through the trial to run for a parliamentary seat, which further delayed punishment for Chun." Jang was assigned to the Gwangju District Court in February 2019 to handle the case but resigned from his judgeship ahead of the April 2020 general election. He ran as a candidate for the Future United Party in Daejeon Yuseong-gap but was defeated. <<> Earlier that day, at the central election committee meeting held at the party headquarters in Yeouido, Seoul, Jang commented on President Lee Jae-myung's criticism of Starbucks' "May 18 Tank Day" and the government's boycott movement, calling it a "local election-style people's trial" and saying, "The deadline for the Starbucks boycott is just until June 3." He added, "Let the people show their will as free citizens that 'I choose my coffee.'" <<> Spokesperson Park said, "Representative Jang is mocking public sentiment by saying about the incident where Starbucks issued an apology and dismissed the person in charge, 'That boycott won't last long.' He should stop belittling the people's Starbucks boycott, as he is the one who quit being a judge during the Chun Doo-hwan trial." <<> Lee Ji-eun, Reporter jieuny@hani.co.kr (조국혁신당은 25일 장동혁 국민의힘 대표의 스타벅스 불매운동 폄훼 발언에 대해 “장 대표는 판사 때 전두환을 처벌할 사법부의 업무를 등한시한 장본인으로, 이제는 5·18의 희생과 공동체 정신을 교묘히 모독하려는 움직임을 앞장서 비호하고 있다”고 비판했다.)

item.title: “Not enough ‘Yoon Again,’ now ‘Park Again’? Insult to the people”… Democratic Party furious over Park Geun-hye’s appearance (“윤 어게인도 모자라 박 어게인? 국민 모독”…박근혜 등판에 민주당 ‘부글’)
item.description:
As former President Park Geun-hye began campaigning for People Power Party candidates in the June 3 local elections, the Democratic Party of Korea criticized it, saying, “Not enough ‘Yoon Again,’ now ‘Park Again’?” and called it “an insult to the people.” <<> Kim Young-ho, a Democratic Party lawmaker serving as co-chair of the election committee for the party’s Seoul mayoral candidate Jung Won-oh, wrote in a Facebook post on the 25th titled “What is this ‘Park Again’ nonsense?” that “The People Power Party has no conscience or sense of shame.” Kim argued, “Not enough ‘Yoon Again,’ now ‘Park Again’?
